That comparison is the most direct nudge toward the lower-calorie option, and it works without triggering the defensiveness that warnings often provoke in young men. Adding plain text warnings (B) probably adds a little more salience to the high-calorie items. The graphic warnings (A, E) grab attention, but young men are likely to tune out or resent them, so E gets less credit than the calorie badge alone. Text-only warnings (D) become wallpaper, and the unlabelled control (F) changes nothing.
